name: CHEM 1138Q
title: Enhanced General Chemistry II
description: Equilibrium, thermodynamics, nuclear chemistry and kinetics. Properties of some of the more familiar elements and their compounds. Equilibrium in solutions and reactions of the common cations and anions in the laboratory component. Can be used as an alternate wherever 1128Q is listed as a prerequisite. CA 3-LAB.
requirement_description: CHEM 1127Q, 1137Q, or 1147Q. Not open to students who have passed CHEM 1126Q or 1128Q or 1148Q.
